title: Rentosertib: AI-designed drug reports Phase IIa results in pulmonary fibrosis
summary: In the GENESIS-IPF study of 71 patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis at 22 centers (placebo versus three doses, 12 weeks), the 60 mg/day group had a mean FVC change of +98.4 mL versus −20.3 mL for placebo. Groups were small, so larger studies are needed; biomarker analysis was exploratory.
ai_technology: Pharma.AI (generative AI for targets and molecules)

evidence.tested: Phase 2a, multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, 71 patients for 12 weeks. Primary endpoint (patients with at least one treatment-emergent adverse event) was similar across arms: 70.6% to 83.3%. Treatment-related serious adverse events were low and comparable.
evidence.unknown: Efficacy in larger and longer trials is not established by this phase 2a study.
evidence.ai_role: Generative AI was used to discover the TNIK target and the small-molecule inhibitor, per the paper's title and abstract.
